fact: The ITU Digital Development Dashboard gives an ITU estimate of 88% of the population using the internet in Libya for 2022 (individuals using the internet, total; no age range given).
77.4 per cent of the population of Libya used the internet in 2021, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
80.6 per cent of the population of Libya used the internet in 2022, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
82.1 per cent of the population of Libya used the internet in 2023, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
